summary: Okta group identifier format change prevents RBAC role resolution for internal tooling
description: Issue summary: After a change in Okta group id formatting in the SCIM sync (rolled 2026-03-11), multiple internal tools are unable to resolve RBAC roles for users who are members of affected groups. Impact: Users see 403s when accessing the internal model-insights and debug-runbooks portals; just-in-time elevation and impersonation flows fail. Environment: prod | us-east | identity-proxy v3.18.1 behind edge-proxy v2.6. Steps to reproduce: 1) Confirm a user is member of an Okta group that was recently updated. 2) Call /v1/internal/resolve-role using user token (or review request headers from an affected service). 3) Observe role resolution error. Observed behavior: Identity proxy receives X-Okta-Groups header with group identifiers that include a new prefix and url-safe base64 encoding; RBAC service stores canonical group ids without the prefix and without padding which causes lookup misses. Expected behavior: Group IDs should canonicalize to the same identifiers stored in RBAC and Okta SCIM, or the identity-proxy should normalize incoming group ids before calling the RBAC service.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use an affected user account (member of updated Okta group).
2) Trigger a login to model-insights (or inspect a failing API call).
3) Check the request headers on identity-proxy (X-Okta-Groups) and compare with RBAC store entries.
4) Attempt role resolution via internal admin endpoint: /internal/admin/roles/resolve?user=<userid> and note missing roles.
logs:
[2026-03-12T08:14:02Z] identity-proxy: INFO incoming headers: X-Okta-Groups=[ok_UG9zZF9iYXNlNjQ%3D, ok_X3Jvb3Q%3D]
[2026-03-12T08:14:02Z] rbac-service: WARN role-lookup miss for group id 'UG9zZF9iYXNlNjQ'
[2026-03-12T08:14:02Z] model-insights: ERROR 403 user uid=alice@example.com missing roles
(Notes: header values appear URL-encoded; RBAC store entries use plain base64 without 'ok_' prefix or percent-encoding.)
investigation_notes: Okta SCIM team confirmed a deploy on 2026-03-11 added an 'ok_' prefix and started emitting url-safe base64 with padding stripped for group IDs to support a new internal index.
Edge-proxy (v2.6) percent-encodes some header values when forwarding; identity-proxy decodes but does not strip the 'ok_' prefix or re-pad base64, so RBAC lookups fail.
Reproduced locally by simulating header values from Okta and observing RBAC lookup flow; adding a normalization step in identity-proxy fixes lookup in our test harness.
No evidence of user account creation or deletion; this is a canonicalization/regression issue rather than a permission removal.
comments: 2026-03-12 09:05 - Aisha Patel: Assigned. Initial hypothesis: header canonicalization mismatch (prefix + base64 padding). Will validate identity-proxy behavior and test normalization patch.

2026-03-12 11:22 - Priya Nair (Okta SCIM): Confirmed change: we introduced 'ok_' prefix to group externalId to avoid collisions; also switched to urlsafe base64 without padding in the payload. We can rollback if necessary but prefer service-side normalization.

2026-03-12 14:40 - SRE (Marco Ruiz): Edge-proxy is percent-encoding header values when proxying to identity-proxy; that combined with 'ok_' prefix causes double-encoded values to reach RBAC. Suggest identity-proxy should perform decode -> strip prefix -> re-pad base64 -> lookup.
2026-03-13 08:18 - Aisha Patel: Created prototype normalization in identity-proxy; local tests pass for role resolution. Preparing PR and canary plan.
resolution: Workaround applied: identity-proxy v3.18.2 (hotfix) deployed to prod-us-east with a header normalization middleware that URL-decodes X-Okta-Groups, strips the 'ok_' prefix, and pads base64 strings before forwarding to RBAC. Long-term: coordinate Okta SCIM change with RBAC canonicalization and add an integration test in identity-proxy suite.
resolution_notes: Hotfix rolled at 2026-03-14 03:12 UTC to prod-us-east; observed role resolution success for previously affected users. Okta SCIM team will add a compatibility header for 2 release cycles; we will revert normalization once all services are migrated or a mutual canonicalization strategy is agreed.
follow_up_actions: 1) Add integration test for Okta group id variants in identity-proxy test suite (owner: Aisha).
2) Schedule coordinated change-window with Okta SCIM for canonical id rollout (owner: Priya).
3) Audit other services that consume X-Okta-Groups header for similar assumptions (owner: SRE).
